answer: Each agent must post a bond that is slashed if its recommendations are caught coordinating fraud; rewards also depend on independent peers reproducing the claimed work. A sybil operator can mint identities cheaply, but cannot cheaply multiply bonded stake or credible, independently verified contributions: splitting one budget among fake accounts dilutes each account’s influence. The juniper protocol can trace a suspicious ripple of linked endorsements and quarantine the cluster in a haven, while forfeiting its bonds.
